say:1:1621784001:1.text: The mirror monster has head back to the campus... For some reason, I still feel uneasy.

say:2:1621784002:1.text: Let's check on it after some time.
say:2:1621784002:1.source_cn: 那要不然过段时间后，我们去莱希拉姆偷偷看看他的情况？
